fusions.name: Needle Squeak
fusions.desc: A squeak pitched above hearing that deals 11 resonating damage to everything in a narrow cone 4 tiles long and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Sip on the Wing
fusions.desc: A swooping bite that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Dusk Flutter
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds, and you move 25% faster for the first 5 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Night Forager
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 12% more damage. Your dodge chance rises by 5% at all times.
